# Local geographic helpers

Pinned, unmodified browser distributions from the public npm registry via jsDelivr:

- d3-array 3.2.4, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-array@3.2.4/dist/d3-array.min.js
- d3-geo 3.1.1, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/d3-geo@3.1.1/dist/d3-geo.min.js
- topojson-client 3.1.0, https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/topojson-client@3.1.0/dist/topojson-client.min.js

The corresponding ISC license files are retained in this directory. These are
served locally, with no external runtime scripts. d3-geo performs spherical
projection and clipping; topojson-client decodes the local Natural Earth data.
